name: io.github.webapper-services/cloudsee-drive
description: Open-source MCP server for CloudSee Drive — connect your CloudSee account (Amazon S3) to Claude and any MCP client.

environmentVariables.name: CLOUDSEE_API_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Your CloudSee Drive API key id.

environmentVariables.name: CLOUDSEE_API_KEY_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The matching CloudSee Drive API key secret.

environmentVariables.name: CLOUDSEE_API_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: API base URL. Optional — defaults to https://drive-api.cloudsee.cloud (UAT: https://drive-api-uat.cloudsee.cloud).

environmentVariables.name: CLOUDSEE_DEFAULT_BUCKET
environmentVariables.description: Optional default drive (S3 bucket) used when a tool call omits bucketName.
